Foundational Models Developing foundational models built for realtime performance from the ground up, with pre and post training, architectures, data pipelines, and controllability designed to integrate seamlessly with our optimizations stack, Low-Level Optimizations Accelerating training, inference, and infrastructure by optimizing directly on kernels, memory and hardware-level systems. Video Editing Building realtime models that can edit and manipulate any video at the pixel level, live. With them, people can transform appearances, change styles, edit clothes, add objects - all while the video is happening What We Build Enterprise-grade performance for real-time AI video and world models Lucy Real-time video editing model. Modify specific elements while preserving the rest, enabling continuous, responsive edits that appear as you type. Oasis Interactive world model. Generate dynamic, playable worlds live from user input, powering synthetic data, real-world simulation, and new interactive experiences. DOS Decart Optimization Stack - A vertically integrated inference and training platform for real-time AI workloads, spanning hardware-aware model design, kernel tooling, proprietary compilers, and inference optimization.
